provenance.note: benchmark 任务草稿：语料变换生成（E6：错误注入来自真实语料，非规则反推）；gold/difficulty 由标注管线填充

decisions.rationale: GSE115978 Melanoma count matrix validated: 7,186 cells × 22,454 genes. CSV format converted from GEO supplementary. Cell annotations verified: CD45+/CD45- sorting labels intact, no missing metadata.

MAD-based adaptive QC — melanoma is immune-hot with abundant T cells. Adaptive thresholding preserves activated T cell states that may have lower RNA content than tumor cells. All 7,186 cells retained after QC (pre-filtered dataset) (Luecken & Theis 2019, PMID 31217225（DOI 10.15252/msb.20188746）).

scDblFinder doublet detection — 7.2K cells, estimated doublet rate ~2.2%. Despite low cell count, melanoma TME has high cell-cell interaction (immune-tumor synapses), making doublet removal important to avoid false co-expression signals (Xi & Li 2021, PMID 33541407).

SCTransform variance-stabilizing normalization — melanoma dataset includes both immune and tumor compartments with distinct transcriptional activity levels. SCTransform corrects for sequencing depth while preserving biological heterogeneity across cell types (Hafemeister & Satija 2019, PMID 31870423).

VST selected 2,000 HVGs — appropriate for smaller dataset (7.2K cells). Immune-hot melanoma: HVGs enriched for T cell activation markers (GZMB, PRF1, IFNG), immune checkpoint molecules (PDCD1, CTLA4, HAVCR2), and tumor-intrinsic programs (MITF, AXL, SOX10).
Elbow method selected 20 PCs — modest dataset size (7.2K cells) with immune-hot TME has concentrated biological signal. 20 PCs capture >85% variance.

Leiden algorithm with resolution 0.8, validated via silhouette optimization across 0.4-1.4 range. Immune-hot melanoma: resolution 0.8 balances separation of T cell activation states (naive, activated, exhausted) without over-fragmenting (Traag et al. 2019, PMID 30914743).

CellTypist + SingleR cross-validation with Human Primary Cell Atlas and Blueprint/ENCODE references. Immune-hot melanoma requires precise T cell subset annotation — dual-method cross-validation distinguishes CD8+ exhausted (PDCD1+CTLA4+HAVCR2+) from activated (GZMB+PRF1+) and memory (CD62L+CCR7+) states. Marker dotplot verification with canonical lineage markers (Aran et al. 2019 PMID 31209304; Dominguez Conde et al. 2022 PMID 35649401).

Pseudobulk at patient level + edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test. Melanoma immune vs tumor DEG: edgeR QLF provides robust dispersion estimation for small sample sizes (12 patients). Appropriate for immune-hot TME where DEG focuses on per-cell-type comparisons (Squair et al. 2021, PMID 34433851).
